title: Drive moves
note: One record per Drive move, written by components/gdrive-creator/gdrive_creator/move.py, LD-89 (tracked Drive moves): which file (its Drive id, kept by the move, and its name), the "Shared Assets/…" folder it left and the one it went to, who moved it, why, and when. Item = the file's Drive id; reviewer = the person the move was made for or by. Read it to answer "where did my X go"; one record per move, never an edit of an earlier one. A move only changes the file's parent: nothing is copied, deleted, trashed or renamed.
